name: RRB
fullName: RRB NTPC, Group D, ALP and JE
intro: Railway recruitment forms now capture your photograph live through the camera. The signature is still uploaded as a scanned file.

documents.label: Photograph
notes: The form captures a live photo through your webcam or phone's front camera.
Use a plain white background and wear non-white, preferably dark, clothing.
Keep the camera at eye level. No cap, mask or spectacles.

documents.label: Signature
notes: Black ink on white paper, in running handwriting (not block capitals).
The full signature must be visible.

source.label: Summary of RRB NTPC Graduate CEN 06/2026 (coaching-site summary, check your CEN)

faqs.q: What is the RRB signature size?
faqs.a: JPG between 30 KB and 49 KB, at least 140 × 60 pixels, scanned at 100 DPI or more from a 35 × 20 mm box.

faqs.q: Why is my RRB signature padded?
faqs.a: A clean signature at this size is usually smaller than 30 KB. The tool adds a harmless comment block inside the file so it meets the minimum without changing how it looks.
